description: Move a handoff to the state named in to. from names the state the handoff is expected to be in now: the move is committed only from exactly that state over an allowed transition, otherwise the answer is a 409 that carries the real state. Repeat a move with the same nonce after a lost answer and the committed transition is returned with repeated true instead of a conflict. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

from.description: The state the handoff is expected to be in now.

handoff_id.description: The handoff_id returned at creation; not a credential.

nonce.description: Your own key for this move, so a repeat after a lost answer is recognized.

token.description: The owner_token or the receiver_token returned once at creation. Both read and advance; the history records which one acted.

name: advance_agent_handoff
title: Advance an agent handoff
